Clew 0.9.0

The Clew Manual

Everything Clew does, explained properly: what to type, what happens, why it works that way, and where the sharp edges are. If you are new, start with the Introduction and read forward; if you came here for one feature, every chapter stands alone.

Tip Clew's bundled demo-vault/ is this manual's live twin — documentation written in Clew, where every guide note exercises the feature it documents. This manual goes deeper and works in any browser; the demo vault lets you poke the features as you read about them. They are best side by side.

What Clew is, the five design commitments behind it, and how it relates to Obsidian.

Installing on macOS, Windows, and Linux; building from source; opening your first vault; a guided tour.

Math and theorems

Queries

Filter notes by folder, tag, and properties; date arithmetic; grouping and sorting — and table cells you can type into.

Tasks and kanban

Vault plugins
